title: Akbar jawaan
body:
Haaye jawan - 4
Akbar jawan - 4
Haye jawan haaye jawan haaye jawan
Haye heeve jeeve jawan thia akbar - 4
Dard ka aasmaan thiya akbar - 2
Haaye jive jive jawan thiya akbar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Koi sughra ku e dasa spane,Kaang veeran di hun laha thive - 2
Maut da mere maathiya akbar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bayn ro ro karendi rahi layla, dekh sughra lahu di mehndi laa - 2
Husn da asman thiya akbar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Baad tere hussain kya jive, tu na sava di hun qaza thive - 2
Tu jo baabe di jaa thiya akbar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Qaatila ku hussain puchda haa, koi meku oja dikhawe cha - 2
Qatl meda jitha thiya akbar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Laash chhut gayi par ae wada hai, par ujake tedi phuphi waisi - 2
Zikr teda jitha thiya akbar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Piyue aakhe jawaan hai laashaa, dekh bachda medi zaeefi da - 2
Kya ajab imtehaan thiya akbar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Pyaas apni te bhul gaya maula, john ro roke ke haake ho ahda - 2
Qatl pani bina thiya akbar - 2
